access_boundary: This record represents the Claude Fable 5 release identified by the dateless pinned ID claude-fable-5, the general-use safeguarded variant of the Mythos-class tier that sits above the Opus class. Anthropic's API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, Claude applications, Claude Mythos 5, and later Fable releases remain separate service or product boundaries.

tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
